subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The canonicalization fix is mechanical, but the PR creates a new public Gateway surface and optional ContextEngine plugin contract with operator/admin semantics that require maintainer API intent.

options.title: Approve After Scoping Fix
options.body: Keep the proposed API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow Read-Only First
options.body: Land only capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that operator action.

options.title: Defer To Plugin/Design Work
options.body: Pause or close the core PR if context-engine maintenance control should stay private or plugin-owned until a broader Gateway control contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve After Scoping Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the multi-agent session-store contract and plugin/Gateway API boundary where steipete has the clearest historical ownership signal.
